message: Decomposed combining mark: the catalog is NFC; write the precomposed letter (ć ń ó ś ź ż ą ę; normalize("NFC")).
Three periods: write one … (U+2026), for progress and for more-input labels.
Space before …: write the ellipsis directly after the word (Wczytywanie sesji…).
Straight double quote in prose: Polish quotes are „…” (U+201E, U+201D), nested «…»; literal code such as /key="value" keeps its quotes.
Wrong quote mark: Polish uses „…” (U+201E opens, U+201D closes), nested «…»; not “ ‘ ’ ‚.
Space before , . ; : ! ?: Polish has none before them and one after (Pole: {path}).
Decimal comma: numbers keep the English format in every locale (0.65, 44.4%; D-05).
Space as the thousands separator: numbers keep the English grouping (1,000; D-05).
Non-breaking or thin space: the catalog uses one plain space (STYLE 14.3).
Hyphen used as a dash: write a spaced en dash " – " for a pause, or recast the sentence.
Polite forms (Pan, Pani, Państwo, proszę) are not used: the UI addresses the user with the bare imperative (Wybierz plik.).
Second-person pronoun or possessive: leave it out (Zastąp zmienione kolory) or, if the sentence needs one, check it against STYLE 14.2.
A button or command opens with the infinitive: write the imperative (Zapisz sesję, Generuj diagram). Only a dialog question may open with an infinitive (Usunąć plik?).
Title Case: only the first word and proper names are capitalized (Zmień nazwę, Zapisz sesję).
English word left in a translation: use the glossary term (cecha, ścieżka, ustawienie wstępne, tor, okno podręczne, domyślny, resetuj, rekord, legenda, etykieta, nić, sesja, ustawienia, płótno).
Strand is nić (nić +, nić −), not pasmo, łańcuch or włókno.
Accession is numer akcesyjny (STYLE 14.1), not numer dostępu.
Term kept in English (STYLE 14.1): GC skew, locus tag, E-value, Bitscore, query, subject, reciprocal best hit.
Diagram is diagram (never mapa) and Track is ścieżka (never trasa, utwór).
Use the glossary verbs: Prześlij (Upload), Pobierz (Download), Wczytaj / Wczytywanie (Load); not wgraj, ściągnij, załaduj, ładowanie.
Cyrillic, Arabic, Thai, CJK or full-width character: the Polish catalog uses Latin letters and ASCII digits only.
Letter or suffix glued to a placeholder: a placeholder is never inflected; put a class noun before it (rekord {record}, plik „{file}”) and rephrase.
Plural written as (y) or (s): counted sentences are plural pairs with one, few, many and other forms.
Polish word without its diacritics (ą ć ę ł ń ó ś ź ż): write błąd, ścieżka, źródło, włącz, wyłącz, usuń, więcej, później, również, został, należy.
